data.input_scope: cached physical windows without online recombination

evidence_boundary: bit-exactness is established against the frozen CPU fixed-point reference
Dense-TM, Sparse-TM, and Sparse-LM-A are whole-network RTL measured for seed2022 validation sample0; both sparse sample0 cycle models match those integrated RTL measurements exactly

the pooled sparse full-validation cycle distributions use an exact per-sample frontend ready/valid FSM replay plus the fixed backend cycle count calibrated by integrated RTL; they are not whole-network RTL measurements for all 1278 seed/sample pairs
200 MHz latency is conditional on Vivado timing closure
mixed adds and MACs are not converted to energy
scheduled lane operations count issued fixed-width arithmetic lanes, not data-dependent switching activity, power, or energy

fixed_point_contract.accumulator_bits_field_meaning: legacy fixed-reference name for the S24 current clamp applied only after the complete dot product; RTL running partial sums are S40

analytical_layer_adjacent_backend_detail.l3_dual_lif_assumption: two cascaded LIF stages sustain the convolution output rate; only pipeline latency, not a 4608-value replay, remains
analytical_layer_adjacent_backend_detail.limitations: analytical double-buffered schedule; controller stalls and routed clock frequency require RTL simulation and Vivado

operation_counts_per_sample.comparison_limit: L1/L2 count only valid in-bounds sparse synapses, while the regular dense backend uses the conventional full-kernel count including same-padding zero taps. The total adds signed additions to MACs and is not a lane-issue, latency, switching, or energy count

Dense_TM.cycle_status: whole-network RTL measured; data-independent dense schedule
Dense_TM.organization: old dense-raster SL-HYB, time-major deep execution

Sparse_LM_A.cycle_status: per-sample frontend is cycle-exact control replay; fixed backend is calibrated from integrated RTL, making seed2022 sample0 exact; full validation distributions are modeled
Sparse_LM_A.organization: sparse L1/L2, L3 current once, layer-adjacent t0/t1 for L4-L8 and H1/H2

Sparse_TM.cycle_status: per-sample frontend is cycle-exact control replay; fixed backend is calibrated from integrated RTL, making seed2022 sample0 exact; full validation distributions are modeled
Sparse_TM.organization: sparse L1/L2, old time-major deep order with L3-current cache

cycles.conditional_200MHz_limit: latency and throughput divide cycle counts by 200 MHz and assume sequential samples without inter-sample overlap; Vivado timing closure and FPGA measurement are still pending

front_end.calibration_limit: the software FSM replay matches one integrated RTL sample exactly; the three full validation distributions use the same complete per-sample packet-dependent control replay

cycle_exact_RTL_control_model.modeled: complete per-sample event rows and L1 nonzero-channel masks; cycle-by-cycle clear, row advance, update, finalize, drain, serialization, end flush, and L1-to-L2 backpressure

integrated_RTL_calibration.model_status: cycle-exact match for all four counters

assumptions.excluded: handshake fill/drain and bank-conflict stalls beyond the stated fixed issue schedule
assumptions.l1_output_packet_serialization: one nonzero channel packet per cycle

assumptions.pool_finalize: one adjacent-column pair for every pre-pool row per cycle

selected_schedule: L1: 400 sorted unit events, add-only S16 weight scatter into S40
L2: nonzero L1 U8 packets, one count-times-S16-weight MAC per synapse
L2: finalize complete output plane so folded-constant defaults are preserved
L3: one dense convolution/current followed by cascaded t0/t1 LIF
L4-L8: shared 288-lane core, layer-adjacent t0/t1 with one weight-tile load
H1/H2: layer-adjacent t0/t1; readout consumes their temporal sum
